reviewed_by: Claude review of switching to an unverified model inside a conversation
reason: In an existing provider conversation the Assistant settings model picker runs runtime_switch_preflight before it moves the selection. Core refuses a model it has no `required-tool-v1` verification for whenever the conversation has tools on -- which is the default -- and proposeProviderRuntime returned on that refusal without calling setModel, so the <select> snapped back to the conversation's saved model and nothing else happened. The verification that would have unblocked it runs from an effect keyed on `model`, so it never fired for a model the operator could not select: the refusal was self-sustaining and the only ways out were the provider card in Settings or starting a new conversation, where proposeProviderRuntime takes its no-session branch, sets the model immediately and lets that effect verify it. A fresh OpenRouter profile verifies models one at a time as they are used, so on the live Core only 5 of the catalogue's models were verified and every other model was unselectable inside an existing chat. ChatRuntimeSwitchPreflight now carries `reason_code` naming each refusal (provider_disabled, model_unavailable, model_not_tool_verified, context_or_privacy) so a caller can act on one without matching prose, and on model_not_tool_verified the picker verifies the model and re-runs the preflight once, exactly as a new conversation does, before reporting any remaining refusal. A verification failure is reported and the selection stays put. test_api pins the new reason_code; interface.spec.ts covers the switch landing after one verification call, and fails without the retry. Rebased onto #405, #413 and #415; the selected suites were re-run on that base and the python count moved from 135 to 137 as those merges added cases to the same files.
exclusions: No frontend unit tests: the changed code is inside SessionsPage's proposeProviderRuntime, which has no unit suite; the client/type change is one mapped field that the new e2e exercises end to end. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No screenshot baselines: no rendered surface changes. Playwright is area:provider-runtime-switch only, on the three profiles that catalogue it (desktop, Android Chromium, iPhone WebKit); the pre-existing compaction-confirmation journey in that area re-runs because it shares proposeProviderRuntime. area:assistant is excluded because it carries the whole assistant-real-desktop real-Core project for a change that does not touch the chat stream, and area:core-api is excluded because the preflight response only gains one optional field. tests/test_playwright_impact.py and tests/test_test_selection.py are included for the manifest edit. No full suites.
